resources.string: Isolated virtual-display automation for AI agents
Permission granted. Phantom can create virtual displays and dispatch input to them.

Phantom uses Shizuku to run automation with shell privileges (virtual displays, display-targeted input). No root required and nothing is sent off-device. Tap Authorize, then approve in the Shizuku prompt.
Permission was denied permanently (“don’t ask again”). Open the Shizuku app, allow Phantom, then tap Reconnect.
This Shizuku version is too old (pre-v11). Update Shizuku, then tap Reconnect.
Install Shizuku (shizuku.rikka.app), start it (wireless debugging on Android 11+, or adb on older releases), then tap Reconnect.
Shizuku is installed but its service is not running. Start it from the Shizuku app, then tap Reconnect.
Virtual-display sessions, app launcher, live viewer, recording, OCR inspection and MCP setup are being rebuilt on top of this Shizuku foundation.
